display_name: Restart a tracked MCP bridge subprocess (terminate + re-spawn)
description: Terminate the tracked bridge subprocess under the supplied agent_instance_id (SIGTERM + grace window + SIGKILL on overrun), then spawn a fresh subprocess in its place under the same id. The new subprocess discovers the current `<solet>.bridge.port` content and connects to the router silently. Used by the FSEvents watcher when `<solet>.bridge.port` content changes (router blue-green swap) so MCP tool calls auto-reconnect without the operator running `/mcp reconnect`. Also called by the iTerm2 plugin's `restart_session` verb. When no prior bridge is tracked, behaves like a fresh spawn (status=not_running with prior_pid=0).
embedding_description: Atomic terminate + spawn of MCP bridge subprocess so the bridge silently reconnects after router blue-green swap or operator restart. Eliminates manual `/mcp reconnect`. Returns BridgeRestartResult: status (success/not_running/failed), agent_instance_id, prior_pid (0 when no prior), new_pid (0 when failed pre-spawn), restarted_at, message. agent_instance_id preserved across restart.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: BridgeRestartResult frozen dataclass with status (success / not_running / failed), agent_instance_id, prior_pid (0 if not_running), new_pid (0 if failed pre-spawn), restarted_at ISO-8601 UTC, and human-readable message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. On status='success', surface both prior_pid and new_pid (the transition the operator can verify with ps). On status='not_running', state that no prior bridge existed and that the new bridge was spawned fresh — equivalent to spawn_bridge. On status='failed', surface the message verbatim and indicate whether the terminate or the spawn step failed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Restart a tracked MCP bridge subprocess (terminate + re-spawn).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: terminate_failed: the SIGTERM step did not complete (kill() denied or grace window expired AND SIGKILL also failed). spawn_failed: terminate succeeded but the fresh subprocess could not be launched.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: terminate_failed: see terminate_bridge recovery guidance. spawn_failed: see spawn_bridge recovery guidance. The tracking entry is preserved on failure so a subsequent restart_bridge call can retry without losing the binding.
